concerns.text: The plan allows a fallback mode (`throttling_mode="time_only"`) when cgroups are unavailable, but the statistical analysis does not control for this variable. Mixing runs with different throttling mechanisms can introduce systematic latency differences that confound the interaction effect between source_type and complexity.

Hypothesis H2 (translation error rates remain stable across complexity) is stated, yet the plan provides no explicit statistical test (e.g., chi‑square for proportions or logistic regression) to evaluate stability. Without a defined analysis, the claim cannot be validated.

All source types are derived from the same DBpedia RDF dump (graph) and a relational view materialized from it. This creates correlated query sets across source types, potentially violating the independence assumption required for ANOVA and inflating Type I error.
Assumptions of ANCOVA (normality, homogeneity of variances) are not addressed nor are diagnostic checks planned. Violations could undermine the validity of the interaction test.
